scope: exception review: name versus regional source concept

records.caution: Current POWO maps the botanical name Celtis ehrenbergiana (Klotzsch) Liebm. to Celtis iguanaea, with 2025 Phytotaxa references; older regional treatments also applied ehrenbergiana broadly to plants treated as C. pallida. The name-level synonym relationship does not identify this source pool's Central Texas observations. C. pallida is separately accepted, so no auto-merge to either C. iguanaea or C. pallida.
records.learner_action: Maintain SOURCE_CONCEPT HOLD and existing C. pallida learner as independent; seek original observation taxon concept/voucher before alias or duplicate learner decisions.
records.hold_resolution: Unresolved; POWO synonym identity alone cannot resolve source specimens
